subject: The Designed Manufactured Installed promise
hook: What you actually get at each of our four steps
ig:
What you actually get at each of our four steps.

Every bespoke furniture company has a process. Here's ours, from your side of the table:

Consultation: free, no obligation, with samples. You leave with ideas, not pressure.

Measure and itemised quote: every element listed, so you can see what's driving the cost and choose where to adjust.

Design sign-off: layout, finish and handles agreed on screen before anything is cut.

Workshop build: made in Hanley, then quality-checked before it leaves.

Installation and handover: our own team fits, scribes, adjusts and shows you how it all works.

The carousel shows a typical example of each stage. If you're comparing quotes, share this with whoever you're planning with so you know what to expect.
fb:
If you've never had furniture made before, it helps to know what happens when. Here's our process from your side.

A free consultation with samples and no obligation. A full measure and an itemised quote, so you can see where the cost sits. A design you approve before anything is cut. The build in our Hanley workshop, checked before it leaves. Then installation by our own team and a proper handover.

The carousel walks through a typical example. Ready to start? Get in touch here:
